title: HelperSSHCloseChannelParams
description: End one proxied channel and release the pooled reference the helper held for it. An id the helper does not hold is answered as closed rather than refused: the ordinary caller is a process shutting down, and making an idempotent act look like a failure is how a shutdown path starts logging errors nobody can act on.

channel.description: The channel to end, as 32 hex characters.
